hook: Your first Indian astronaut crew member may be a robot.
title: India Is Sending a Robot Woman to Space
description:
ISRO plans to fly Vyommitra, a female-looking humanoid robot, on an uncrewed Gaganyaan test flight. She can talk and acts as a stand-in for a human crew member. It is a rehearsal for sending Indians to space.

#Shorts #Space #ISRO
comment_prompt: Robot or human first? Robot or human
